**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 13 satisfies the preferred position on all material terms:

- **Affiliates and contractors (13.1):** the subscription grant runs directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," plus Authorized Users — better than the fallback, which would only require affiliate coverage on written notice.
- **Perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licences (13.2):** paid-up and embedded software is licensed perpetually, irrevocably, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, to Customer and its Affiliates, with contractor support rights.
- **No revocation at will (13.3):** suspension/revocation is limited to a material uncured payment or use breach, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity.
- **Successor transfer (13.3 + 24.1/24.4):** transfer to an Affiliate or M&A successor is permitted without Vendor consent, and change of control gives Vendor no termination, repricing or service-reduction right.
- **Use restrictions (13.4, sec-12):** customary reverse-engineering/security/legality limits only, expressly carved back for authorized security testing and Customer Data and output — they do not narrow the grant below the fallback.
